title: Hart signs new Chelsea contract until 2034
content: Chelsea confirmed Leo Hart has signed a new contract until 2034. The deal is reported to be worth £150,000 a week, making him one of the top earners since his £42.5m arrival in 2023.

title: Price completes loan move to Cologne
content: Tottenham Hotspur forward Sam Price has completed a season-long loan move to 1. FC Köln. He said players who moved to Germany before him, including a winger later sold for £73m, inspired the decision.

title: Everton sign Kai Brooks on loan from Brighton
content: Everton have signed Kai Brooks on a season-long loan from Brighton, paying a £2m loan fee.

title: Brentford sign Ali Musa from Genk
content: Brentford have completed the signing of Ali Musa from Genk for an undisclosed fee. Genk paid £4m for him in 2022.

title: Villa complete Rui Lopes signing
content: Aston Villa have completed the signing of Rui Lopes from Braga. The move follows the £35m sale of Ben Ode to Chelsea last week.

title: Newcastle make offer to free agent Theo Grant
content: Newcastle United have offered free agent Theo Grant a contract worth £200,000 a week, but no agreement has been reached.

title: Bayern complete €40m move for Luca Ferri
content: Bayern Munich have completed the signing of Luca Ferri from Atalanta for €40m, with a further €5m in add-ons. The fee is roughly £34m.

title: Hearts sign Dan Kerr from Ross County

title: Real Madrid interested in Nico Vidal
content: Real Madrid are interested in Real Sociedad midfielder Nico Vidal, who has a €60m release clause.

title: Mark Doyle joins Stoke on a free transfer
content: Free agent Mark Doyle has joined Stoke City after leaving Hull City at the end of his contract.
